author: Good Enough
description:
During the Cold War, intelligence agencies developed some of the most unusual tools imaginable, designed for situations where secrecy was everything.

One of these concepts involved a hidden toolkit that could be concealed in a way no one would expect. Despite the extreme design and planning behind it, the device was never successfully used in the field.

This Short explores one of the strangest ideas ever created for espionage, and why it ultimately failed.

title: The CIA's Most Unusual Spy Toolkit 🕵️‍♂️😲 #didyouknow #unbelievable #history #facts
